description: This file defines the interface for a calculator module within the Rte (Runtime Environment), including a function for multiplication. It appears to be part of a larger automotive software architecture, specifically for the TMS570 MCU, and provides function declarations and dependencies related to the Rte module.

methods.name: Multiply
methods.description: Performs multiplication of two 8-bit unsigned integers and stores the result in a 16-bit unsigned integer pointer.
